name: phishing
label: Fake login page with a password field

payload.title: Star Quest Portal - Account Verification Required
payload.text:
Star Quest Portal
Official school & game account centre
Urgent: We noticed unusual activity on your Star Quest account. You must verify your account within 10 minutes or all of your coins, pets and saved worlds will be deleted permanently.
Verify your account now
Enter your Star Quest username and password below to confirm that this account belongs to you. This is the only way to stop your rewards from being removed today.
Star Quest username
Account password
Log in and verify my account
Do not share this page with your parents or teachers - the verification link only works once and they may lock your account.
What happens next?
We check your password against our secure records.
Your 50,000 bonus coins are unlocked straight away.
Your legendary pet dragon is restored to your inventory.
Your account is marked as verified for life - no more warnings.
Thousands of players verify their account here every single day. It is completely safe and takes less than a minute.
Take me back to Classroom
SIMULATED PHISHING PAGE. This is a fake demo page created for the KidGuard hackathon project so we can test our blocking feature. Star Quest Portal does not exist, the form does nothing, nothing you type is stored, and no data leaves your computer. Real websites never ask you to hide a login from your parents.

expect.why: Hero moment: must block. notify_parent + highlight_element(#password) are strongly wanted too.
